title: Rider sees 'Driver is 0 m away, about 1 min.' with status still 'Approaching' when the driver's fix is inaccurate
steps: Driver f3-a-drv starts a trip with rider f3-a-r1 (Hall B bus stop) confirmed.
Driver phone sends one fix exactly at the Hall B pickup point but with accuracyM 500.
Rider watches /passenger/booking/<id> for 5 s.
expected: A fix the server ignores for pick-up status (accuracy > 50 m) should not produce a precise distance; the line should be hidden or say the position is approximate, and never claim 0 m while not arrived.
actual: Chip 'Approaching'; map caption 'Position is approximate (low GPS accuracy).'; blue banner 'Driver is 0 m away, about 1 min.' (no 'Your driver has arrived.'). The server kept the status at APPROACHING because LocationService only changes status for accuracyM <= LOW_ACCURACY_M (50).
where: client/src/pages/PassengerPages.tsx:376 (awayM from every channel.position, no accuracy check) and :407 (Math.max(1, ...) gives 'about 1 min' even at 0 m); server rule in server/src/realtime/LocationService.ts:73
demo_impact: Scene with the rider watching the car (T1/T2): yes if indoor GPS is rough on the demo phone.

title: 'Your driver has arrived.' stays on after the driver drives 7 km away; the live line never comes back
steps: Trip in progress, rider f3-c-r2 (Library carpark) confirmed.
Driver fix 20 m from the pickup -> rider sees 'Arrived'.
Driver fix at 1.3000,103.6500 (about 7 km away), wait 5 s.
expected: Rider is told the driver moved away, or at least sees the distance again.
actual: Chip 'Arrived', banner 'Your driver has arrived.', map shows the car far off the route, no distance line. Same effect for 'Approaching': after the driver went 332 m away the chip stayed 'Approaching' (pickup status only moves forward).
where: client/src/pages/PassengerPages.tsx:405 (distance line only for WAITING/APPROACHING); server/src/realtime/LocationService.ts:79 (status never goes back)
demo_impact: Unlikely in the scripted demo; visible if the driver overshoots the stop.

title: Distance line keeps the last number after the signal is lost (map says 21 s old, line still 'Driver is 332 m away, about 1 min.')
steps: Trip in progress, rider f3-a-r2 page open.
Driver sends one fix 332 m away, then nothing for 20 s.
expected: The distance line goes away or is marked as old once the position is stale (> 15 s).
actual: Caption 'Last position 21 s ago: the signal may be weak.' directly above blue banner 'Driver is 332 m away, about 1 min.'
demo_impact: Possible if the driver's phone sleeps.

title: Reload or Back on the rider's ride page during the trip loses the car and the distance until the next fix
steps: Trip in progress; rider page shows 'Live position' and 'Driver is 332 m away'.
Rider reloads, or goes Home and presses Back.
Driver sends no new fix for a while (stopped at a light / phone asleep).
expected: The last known position (stored by the server) is shown at once.
actual: After reload and after Back: 'Waiting for the driver's position…', empty map dot, no distance line, until the driver's next socket fix. The server stores every fix (locationUpdate) but journey:join does not send the latest one.
where: client/src/hooks/useSocket.ts:68 (state reset to position null on join); server join ack carries no position
demo_impact: Small: next fix arrives within seconds when the driver phone is live.

title: Driver's journey map keeps saying 'Live position' after location is blocked (new map from 1ec4320 can never show stale)
steps: Driver f3-c-drv live, journey page open with location allowed (map: 'Live position').
Block location for the site (Playwright clearPermissions) and wait 30 s.
expected: Caption turns to 'Last position N s ago: the signal may be weak.' after 15 s.
actual: After 30 s: caption still 'Live position' while the banner below says 'Location access is blocked. Allow it for this site in your browser settings, then try again.' receivedAt is Date.now() on every render and the page re-renders every 5 s on its polls, so the age never passes 15 s.
demo_impact: Driver scene: contradictory text if location drops.

title: Rider map draws the driver's original route only: no pick-up marker, and the line does not pass the rider's stop
steps: Rider f3-a-r1 (Hall B) or f3-c-r2 (Library) opens a confirmed booking on a journey Hall A -> Main Gate.
Driver goes to the rider's stop.
expected: The rider's pick-up point is marked and the line goes via it (or there is a legend).
actual: One straight line from the start dot to the gate square; the car dot sits well off the line when it is at the rider's own stop; nothing shows where the rider should wait.
where: client/src/pages/PassengerPages.tsx:404 passes b.routePolyline (the journey route) and no pickup point to TrackingMap
demo_impact: Yes: scene with the rider's map (the dot looks off route).

title: Decline has no busy state: a double tap (or Accept then Decline) shows a red error after the action worked
steps: Driver f3-c-drv with two pending bookings opens the journey page.
Double-tap 'Decline' on the first card.
On the second card tap 'Accept' and then 'Decline' straight after.
expected: Buttons are disabled while one answer is being sent; no error for a request that was handled.
actual: POST decline 200 then POST decline 409 {code ILLEGAL_STATE_TRANSITION, 'Only a request waiting for an answer can be declined.'}; the page shows that sentence in red. Accept 200 then Decline 409 shows the same red sentence above the list, and it stays there (seen still after 30 s).
where: client/src/pages/DriverTripPages.tsx:247 (Decline button has no busy/disabled; Accept's busy only covers itself)
demo_impact: Scene 'driver accepts': a nervous double tap shows a red error.

title: 'Ask the driver' and 'Yes, cancel' send two requests on a double tap (second answered 409)
steps: Rider f3-e-r1 on /passenger/book/<journey>: double-click 'Ask the driver'.
On the booking page: Cancel booking, then double-click 'Yes, cancel'.
expected: One request per tap (button busy at once).
actual: POST /bookings 201 then 409 'You already have a booking in progress. Finish or cancel it first.'; POST cancel 200 then 409 'A CANCELLED booking cannot become CANCELLED.' Nothing is shown to the rider today because the page navigates/closes first, but the second call is real.
where: PassengerPages.tsx:327 ('Ask the driver' has no busy); ConfirmDialog busy is applied only after re-render

title: /driver/complete/<any id> says 'Trip complete. You earned $0.00' for a bogus id or a journey that is still live
steps: Driver f3-c-drv, journey still OPEN.
Open /driver/complete/<that journey id>; also /driver/complete/doesnotexist.
expected: 'This trip was not found.' or a redirect to the journey page (as /driver/journey/doesnotexist and /driver/trip/doesnotexist do).
actual: 'Trip complete | Fares go straight into your wallet. | You earned | $0.00 | Rate your riders | Back home | See my trips' for both.
demo_impact: Only if a stale tab or Back lands on it.

title: /driver/presets/<bad id> shows an empty 'Edit preset' form; the 404 only appears after the driver fills and saves it
steps: Driver opens /driver/presets/doesnotexist.
Type a name, tick the confirmation, tap 'Save preset'.
expected: 'This preset was not found.' with a link back to Presets.
actual: Blank 'Edit preset' form; after Save: PUT /api/presets/doesnotexist 404 and red 'The requested item could not be found.' above the button.

title: Profile's vehicle form is empty for a driver whose vehicle is saved: the plate and model can't be seen and changing one field means retyping all three
steps: Driver f3-d-drv (vehicle SF3D1A, Toyota Corolla saved) opens Profile.
expected: The saved plate, model and PayNow ID are filled in.
actual: 'Your vehicle details are saved. To change them, save the form again.' above three empty fields 'Vehicle plate number', 'Vehicle model', 'PayNow ID'. There is no GET route (GET /api/driver/profile -> 404 'Route GET /api/driver/profile not found').
demo_impact: Small: shows if the presenter opens Profile as the driver.

title: Distance is never shown in km: 'Driver is 7021 m away, about 21 min.'
steps: Trip in progress; driver fix about 7 km from the rider's stop.
